title: Behaviour checks: before/after in one run, stored results
goal: A rule change shows per-scenario passes at a ref and at the working tree, and runs are kept for comparison
acceptance: behaviour run --rules-ref=<ref> builds both fixture sets and prints before and after per scenario
Each run appends per-scenario counts to .harness/behaviour.jsonl (no transcripts)
Fixture tests in tools/test-tools.mjs, failing first
core/docs/agents/rule-review.md says how; CHANGELOG; next minor release
privacy: Rule and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories; no personal data.
escalation: Rule text differing materially from the accepted draft goes back to the owner
